snippet.title: TheGoldenSeam Trailer
snippet.description:
Something precious lies broken. Piece by piece, you'll put it back together.

The Golden Seam draws on kintsugi, the Japanese art of repairing pottery with gold. It doesn't hide the cracks. It fills them, traces them, makes them the most beautiful part of the object. What was once broken becomes something new and precious, its scars on display.

Turn each broken shape. Slide the pieces until they meet. Watch the seam fill with gold. One crack at a time, the chaos settles into calm, laced with the golden trace of where it once was broken.

There are no timers here. No score. No way to fail. Just your hands and the slow, steady calm of putting something back together, piece by piece. The click of each piece, the warmth of each seam sealing home.

When the last crack closes, what's left isn't what it was before. It's something that carries its history, its scars, in gold. No two are ever the same. Neither are we.

A small, quiet game to find some calm with.

Made by two people, with love.
